title: Accelerate Agency Creation
description: Reduce the time required to create a complete agency specification from days to hours through AI-assisted design and automated artifact generation.
rationale: Manual agency creation is currently a bottleneck for platform growth. Enabling rapid prototyping and deployment of new agencies accelerates solution delivery.
success_metrics: Agency specification generated in < 2 hours (vs. 2-3 days manual)
90% reduction in specification errors
5+ agencies created per week (vs. 1 per month currently)

title: Ensure Specification Quality
description: Generate agency specifications that are complete, consistent, and compliant with platform standards on first generation.
rationale: Poor quality specifications lead to runtime issues, require rework, and undermine trust in the Genesis Agency.
success_metrics: 100% of generated specifications pass validation checks
Zero missing required fields (introduction, goals, roles, work items)
RACI matrix completeness: all work items covered
Consistency checks: role references valid, goal-to-work-item traceability

title: Enable Domain Expert Collaboration
description: Allow non-technical domain experts to drive agency design through natural language dialogue, removing technical barriers.
rationale: Domain expertise resides with business stakeholders, not platform engineers. Democratizing agency creation unlocks this knowledge.
success_metrics: Domain experts complete agency design without developer assistance
80% user satisfaction score in usability testing
Average 10 questions to reach publishable specification
Users can answer questions without needing technical documentation

title: Capture Organizational Knowledge
description: Extract and formalize agency design patterns from successful deployments, creating reusable templates and best practices.
rationale: Similar agencies share structural patterns (e.g., all logistics agencies need receiving/storage/shipping). Capturing these accelerates future designs.
success_metrics: Library of 10+ agency templates by domain
Pattern reuse in 60% of new agency designs
Template-based agencies require 50% fewer questions
Knowledge base updated after each successful deployment

title: Generate Complete Deployment Artifacts
description: Produce all artifacts needed to deploy a new agency: specifications, database schemas, configuration files, and deployment manifests.
rationale: Incomplete artifact generation still requires manual work. True automation means zero post-generation editing required.
success_metrics: 100% of required artifacts generated automatically
Artifacts deployable without manual modification
Database initialization scripts execute successfully first time
Workflow JSON files load without validation errors

title: Support Iterative Refinement
description: Enable users to review, critique, and refine any part of the generated specification through conversational interaction.
rationale: First-pass generation won't be perfect. Users need easy ways to request changes without starting over.
success_metrics: Users can refine individual sections without regenerating entire spec
Refinement requests processed in < 30 seconds
90% of refinement requests result in acceptable output
Change history tracked for audit and rollback

title: Maintain Agency Consistency
description: Ensure all generated agency components align with each other and follow platform conventions consistently.
rationale: Inconsistent specifications cause runtime errors (e.g., RACI matrix references non-existent roles, work items link to non-existent goals).
success_metrics: Zero cross-reference errors in generated specs
All role names match across sections
Goal-to-work-item traceability 100% complete
Naming conventions followed (IDs, codes, titles)

title: Document Design Decisions
description: Capture rationale for key design decisions made during agency creation for future reference and learning.
rationale: Understanding why design choices were made helps with future modifications and knowledge transfer.
success_metrics: Design rationale documented for major decisions
Traceability from requirements to design choices
Decision log exportable for documentation
Rationale included in generated artifacts

title: Scale to Multiple Agency Types
description: Support creation of agencies across diverse domains (infrastructure, healthcare, logistics, finance, etc.) without domain-specific customization.
rationale: Platform value grows with agency diversity. Genesis Agency must be domain-agnostic.
success_metrics: Successful agency generation in 5+ different domains
No domain-specific code changes required
Template library covers 80% of common patterns
Cross-domain knowledge transfer demonstrated

title: Integrate with Platform Lifecycle
description: Seamlessly integrate with existing agency management, publishing, and activation workflows.
rationale: Genesis Agency output must feed directly into the platform's agency lifecycle (draft → published → activated).
success_metrics: Generated agencies transition to 'draft' state automatically
Publishing workflow validates Genesis Agency output
Activation succeeds without manual intervention
Existing tools (Agency Designer, Workflow Designer) work with generated specs
